desktop.notesZh: demo6 十四问题批次：① 会话统计三段分区美化（概览/工具/Tokens，宽行键值、合计高亮）② 影响范围随计划白名单落定（1→单文件、≤3→局部小改、否则跨模块）③ 摘要并入行式布局与模式/类型同款 ④ 总览点击状态卡片看完整记录（含产物可点开）⑤ 完成卡耗时/Tokens 不为 — ⑥ 类型/范围按阶段更新（confirm 落类型、plan 落范围）⑦ 任务计数改「计划任务」并悬停说明 ⑧ 置信度悬停解释 40%/70% 规则 ⑨ 阶段切换统一四行汇报骨架（阶段/本回合做了什么/产物/下一步）⑩ 默认归属当前变更（明显无关才弹 active-conflict）⑪ 刷新… 常驻修复（dashboard 死循环根因）⑫ 合并右侧栏底部 actions 卡到顶栏 ⑬ 阶段详情统一结构 + 通俗说明 + 常见失败与处理错误码速查 ⑭ 顶栏手动刷新走静默通道不再闪烁。0.0.16/17/18 累计：六问题批次（确认推进自动派单+账本重置 / plan.md 由账本渲染 / 流程图每阶段 token 与耗时 / 归档进入完成态可回看 / 变更总览升级为 dashboard 含统计磁贴）。
desktop.notesEn: demo6 fourteen-issue batch: (1) session stats now three sections (Overview/Tools/Tokens) with wide labeled rows and a highlighted total; (2) affected scope settles from the plan allowlist on plan completion (1 file → single, ≤3 → small-local, else cross-module); (3) summary rides the labeled metaRow style with mode/kind/scope; (4) clicking any status card opens full records (classification card + every artifact, click-to-open); (5) the completed card shows 0/real figures, never —; (6) intake kind settles at confirm, scope settles at plan (archive is a backstop); (7) the 任务 counter is now labeled 计划任务 with a hover explanation; (8) initial confidence hover explains the 40%/70% base/keyword rules; (9) every state transition uses a unified four-line report skeleton (stage / what this turn did / artifacts / next step); (10) follow-ups inside an active change are attributed by default — only clearly unrelated input pops the active-conflict card; (11) stuck 刷新… fixed (the dashboard effect loop is gone); (12) the right-rail's bottom generic-actions card merged into the top bar; (13) stage details are unified with a 通俗说明 section and a 常见失败与处理 error-code quick-reference table; (14) top-bar manual refresh goes through a silent channel — no flicker. Plus the 0.0.16/17/18 rollup: gate-confirm auto-dispatch with re-armed per-session ledger, plan.md rendered from the plan.json ledger, per-stage tokens/duration on the graph, archive enters a visible completed state with clickable history, and the change overview upgraded to a dashboard with summary tiles.
